messages:
Maria: Heads-up — started seeing a spike of 413s from /v1/embeddings when customers send mixed-dim batches. Console shows them as preflight failures, but some should be routable.
Kevin: Can you paste a sample payload? I suspect splitter -> router size calc is over-conservative for heterogenous dims.
Maria: sample payload below (sanitized):
```json
{"input":[{"id":"a","dims":768,"data":"..."},{"id":"b","dims":1024,"data":"..."},{"id":"c","dims":768,"data":"..."}],"model":"embed-open-1"}
```
Also header we get from customer: `X-Embed-Dims: 768,1024,768`

Jun: OK. Two ideas: (1) preflight compute per-dim byte budgets instead of whole-payload bytes, so 768-dim items route to slot A and 1024 to slot B, or (2) soft-quota fallback: accept request but stream partial success + per-item rejection with 207. Prefer (2) for UX.
Tara: Telemetry caveat — if we do (2) we need per-item tracking and a new console metric `embed.preflight.partial_accept` + histogram `embed.dim_distribution`. Without that dashboards will look noisy and oncall will flip out.
Kevin: Implementation sketch: preflight reads dims header (fall back to sampling), computes slot map, then consults routing policy: if mixed and payload > threshold -> either split (preferred) or soft-throttle. Add `X-Embed-Routing-Decision: split|throttle|reject` to logs. Quick patch: splitter will emit `batch_signature` for router to use.
Maria: For rollout UX: can we gate this behind a console flag per-org? Default off; enable for specific tenants (canary 1%, 10%). Also need a console toggle describing behavior: "split into per-dim sub-batches" vs "soft-fail per-item".
Jun: Agree on console toggle. Also recommend a kernel-level timeout tweak — splitting increases number of downstream requests and can spike p99 if we don't raise assembly window by ~20ms.
Tara: I'll add dashboard cards: 1) preflight reject rate, 2) partial accept rate, 3) mean downstream calls per embed request. Also add an alert: partial_accept > 5% sustained = warn.
Kevin: Plan for headers/telemetry: add `X-Embed-Preflight` (ok|partial|reject) and emit structured log like `embed.preflight={dims:[768,1024],decision:"split"}` to our observability pipeline.
Maria: Can we do a console rollout flow: default config = `split_on_mixed_dims=true,soft_quota=false`, and have a quick kill switch? Need runbook for incidents (if p99 rises after enabling split).
deploy-bot: deploy service/embed-splitter v2.3.0 canary -> 1% started by @kevin
telemetry-bot: metric embed.preflight.partial_accept incremented by 9 in the last 5m (sources: canary hosts)
Kevin: I'll own the canary, monitor p50/p95/p99 and partial_accept. If p99 > baseline+40ms I will flip split_on_mixed_dims=false. Assigning follow-ups: @Jun for router heuristics, @Tara for dashboards/runbook.
Maria: thanks — will coordinate with support for affected tenants and draft customer note if we enable soft-fail. :thumbsup:
